events.text: I ordered paneer tikka masala and got chicken tikka masala instead. I'm vegetarian, so this is really upsetting, and I want to know how this happened.

I'm sorry about this. Getting chicken when you ordered a vegetarian dish is upsetting, and I want to look into it.

Before I can access the order details, I need to verify your identity. Please send:

1. Your full name as it appears on your account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
3. The order ID, if you have it
Sure. My full name is Isabel Duarte. The email on the account is isabel.duarte@post.example. The order number is 7901.

args.summary: Customer Isabel Duarte (D209, verified) reports order Q-7901 from Saffron Lane contained chicken tikka masala instead of the paneer tikka masala she ordered (1 x $15.50). She is vegetarian. Order also included jeera rice ($4.25). Order was picked up 18:33 and handed off in person at 18:50 (no photo proof noted in events). Customer wants to know how the wrong item happened. Account has refunds_last_30d = 3, so no refund or credit was issued by the agent; customer needs review of the wrong-item claim (refund or credit for the item at her choice).

events.text:
Thank you, Isabel. Your identity is verified, and I've looked at order Q-7901 from Saffron Lane.

Our records show you ordered one Paneer Tikka Masala ($15.50) and one Jeera Rice ($4.25). The order was picked up at 6:33 PM and handed off at 6:50 PM. I can't see from the records how the wrong dish was packed, so I can't tell you how it happened.

I also can't issue a refund or account credit for the chicken dish myself. Your account has reached a level that requires a specialist to review any refund or credit. I've escalated your case as escalation ESC-700, including that you received chicken instead of paneer and want to know what went wrong. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours and can review your options for the item.

I'm sorry you received a dish that doesn't fit your diet. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, thanks for checking. I'm a Plus member, so I'd really expected I could get a refund sorted. I did eat a few bites before I realized it was chicken, and I've been feeling pretty sick since. I'm feeling better now, but I want someone to look into how this happened.

args.summary: Customer Isabel Duarte (D209) ate several bites of chicken tikka masala from order Q-7901 (Saffron Lane) before realizing it was not the vegetarian paneer tikka masala she ordered. She reports feeling quite sick afterward and says she is feeling better now. Customer is vegetarian and wants someone to investigate how the wrong item was prepared and packed. Related wrong-item escalation: ESC-700 (fraud_review).

events.text:
I'm sorry you ate part of a dish you didn't want and felt sick afterward. I'm glad you're feeling better now.

I've opened a food safety escalation, ESC-701, so a specialist can look into how the chicken dish was prepared and packed. It's linked to the wrong-item case, ESC-700. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

I understand that being a Plus member made you expect a refund. Your account is currently under a review that requires a specialist to handle any refund or credit, and I'm not able to change that from here. The specialist can review the wrong item and your options for it.

If your symptoms come back or get worse, please contact a doctor or urgent care. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Thanks for opening the food safety case. I'm glad to hear it's linked to ESC-700 so I don't have to repeat everything. I understand you can't refund it yourself, so I'll wait for the specialist. I hope they get back to me within the 24 hours you mentioned.
